No background music. === VIDEO SUMMARY === Riven and Ally Soldier have stopped walking on the mountain road while the large army continues marching past them. Riven realizes the army will continue toward her home unless she openly stops them. She shouts for the army to stop. The soldiers gradually react and turn their attention toward her. Riven then steps forward alone while Ally Soldier remains behind. A nearby soldier orders Riven to move. Riven refuses and draws her sword. The video ends with Riven standing against the large army while Ally Soldier remains behind her as her companion, not her opponent. === SCENES === Shot 1 Riven stands completely still on the mountain road. Ally Soldier stands slightly behind her and to one side. The large army is still marching. SOLDIERS continue walking past Riven and Ally Soldier on both sides. Riven watches them continuing forward. Her conflicted expression becomes determined. She raises her head and shouts: "STOP!" Shot 2 Cut to a wider cinematic view. The SOLDIERS closest to Riven react first. They slow down and turn toward her. The reaction spreads naturally through the marching army. More soldiers gradually stop and look toward Riven. Reveal the scale of the large army filling the mountain road. Shot 3 Riven takes a few steps forward alone. Ally Soldier stays behind and watches her. He does not draw his weapon. Riven and Ally Soldier do not confront each other. A nearby ordinary SOLDIER ahead of Riven says: "Riven. Move." Shot 4 Riven stops. She draws the exact sword shown in the Riven reference. The surrounding SOLDIERS become tense, but nobody attacks. Riven keeps her sword lowered and looks toward the soldiers in front of her. She says: "No. I'm protecting my home." Shot 5 End on a powerful wide cinematic shot. Riven stands with her sword drawn facing the large army. Many SOLDIERS fill the mountain road in front of her and extend into the distance. Ally Soldier remains behind Riven and off to one side. He has not drawn his weapon. The confrontation is between Riven and the army. No combat begins. End immediately.
